messages:
jess-marshall: quick q — we're seeing the client prefer the proxy host even when SDK `base_url` in code is set to the private endpoint. expected behavior?
omar-khan: what combo of env + config? list what you set locally.
jess-marshall: repro: `REDWOOD_BASE_URL=https://private-123.vpc.redwood svc_proxy=http://localhost:3128` then in node client: `new RedwoodClient({ baseUrl: 'https://private-123.vpc.redwood' })` -> client goes via localhost:3128.
leni: that sounds like our HTTP layer respects `HTTP(S)_PROXY` higher than SDK baseUrl. I think proxy env wins for outbound routing.
omar-khan: confirm — we intentionally let OS/HTTP layer proxy env override to avoid bypassing corporate proxies. but we do have a `skipProxy` config flag in the js client that can force direct.
jess-marshall: omg that flag! where is it documented?
leni: it's in devex readme under "advanced networking". short snippet:
```js
const c = new RedwoodClient({ baseUrl: 'https://private-123.vpc.redwood', network: { skipProxy: true } })
```
omar-khan: note: for streaming there's also `preferDirectForStreaming: true` — otherwise the proxy may not support chunked responses and streams hang.
jess-marshall: we hit that — stream stuck in pending until we removed proxy. can we log a clearer warning when `skipProxy` not set and baseUrl is private?
leni: yeah we can add a warn in the next patch on client init when `baseUrl` matches `*.vpc.redwood` and proxy env detected. small PR.
jess-marshall: awesome. can someone quick review? PR coming from me in ~30m. ping @omar-khan for perf owner.
omar-khan: will review. also add an e2e that sets `HTTP_PROXY` to simulate corporate env, so we don't regress.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: devex/docs-site (branch=jess/vpc-proxy-warn) — build 482 in CI starting. :rocket:
jess-marshall: thanks team. Leni, can you add a short note in the migration doc about `preferDirectForStreaming`? I'll include the skipProxy example in the README PR.
leni: yep adding now.
omar-khan: one more gotcha — on windows we observed `NO_PROXY` parsing differences (semicolon vs comma) so include that in tests.
jess-marshall: noted. last Q: should sdk prefer `NO_PROXY` hosts over `skipProxy` flag?
leni: `skipProxy` is explicit override from user-level code; NO_PROXY is env-level. behavior: explicit SDK config > NO_PROXY > system proxy. will document.
jess-marshall: perfect. closing thread after PR lands. thanks :thumbsup:
